description: raw-recurrence-v2 plus the declared, held harness_bench cohort (pi harness trajectories; text twins per tokenizer; recurrence with written views after runtime qualification). Shared by every line. History: recipes/HISTORY.md.

harness_bench.admission: held: the owner and both recipe owners (Pop for the LFM line, the DGX Mellum session) must admit the cohort before any stage reads it (HARNESS_BENCH.md §6/§7). Declaring it here admits nothing.

source.per_record_admission: harness-bench-criteria/2 (each record's training_admission.approved: resolved, pi-replayed-verified, exact-mapping)

harness_bench.backbone_inherent_differences: tokenizer and chat template only (one twin per tokenizer from the same records and renderer); Mellum's nested members train on the same rows through the line's member_* parameters. history_reasoning (declared per backbone, owner 2026-10-10; serve/chat.py BACKBONE_HISTORY_REASONING, asserted by the renderer and recorded in each twin receipt; serving renders the same): every line trains the target turn's reasoning; earlier assistant turns' reasoning follows each backbone's post-training template default, LFM2.5 last_turn_only (only the most recent assistant turn of a rendered conversation keeps its reasoning; preserve_thinking is never set), Mellum2.1 keep (every assistant turn after the last user query keeps it)

mix.policy: added to the line's existing native text cohort of each listed stage, never replacing it
mix.weight_unit: fraction of the stage's training text windows drawn from this cohort (the native cohort keeps the rest)
mix.held_documents: the twin's test split (112 documents, held repositories) is reported as its own stratum, not merged into the native held set

supervision.text_warmup_policy: TEXT_POSITION_WEIGHT_POLICY: half of each annotated window's loss uniform over all positions (task, earlier turns, tool outputs and view previews; the system prompt masked as for every cohort), half on the record's assistant target suffix
supervision.feedback_weight_meaning: relative weight, inside the context term, of tool results and other mechanical feedback (the trajectory trainer's --feedback-weight semantics)
supervision.feedback_weight_status: implemented in shared train/text_supervision.py and the text_warmup loader/objective; tool-result context is weighted at 0.25, reasoning and replies remain full weight. Controlled training handoff and admission review are still required; the frozen Pop job is unchanged.

recurrence.after: each student's runtime qualification for its exact weights (adapted_runtime) and the view operator stage gate (TRAINING_RECIPE.md 'The view operator stage'); for Mellum every nested member is an objective
recurrence.status: declared, not admitted; shared raw_recurrence_training handler now carries view, view_window, context_weight and feedback_weight. Exact-weight runtime and view-operator qualification remain required.

harness_bench.notes: Each document is one record (task, whole earlier trajectory, one target turn); a trajectory contributes up to 8 records, so its prefix recurs in each, and about 1% of a twin's tokens are target suffix. The window sampler should therefore draw windows per document, not per token.
